notes: Official USGS public-domain data; no licence restriction (USGS data are public domain, https://www.usgs.gov/information-policies-and-instructions/copyrights-and-credits).
Rows with type in {explosion, quarry blast, mining explosion, anthropogenic event} are flagged, not silently deleted: the analysis removes them explicitly.
horizontalError is the catalogue's own 1-sigma epicentre uncertainty in km; it is used as the location-uncertainty weight (arXiv:1304.6912).
